en: Sepia-toned photograph of a brick building on a cobblestone street, showing five young women in dresses standing and posing around the entrance. Large windows with curtains line the facade. Next to the doorway there is a vertical signboard with a full-length figure of a man in a coat and hat and some small text beneath, suggesting a shop or business entrance. A bicycle wheel is visible at the right edge of the image. The style of clothing and architecture suggests an early-20th-century urban setting.
